title: JM Press
summary: A hybrid of a close-grip bench press and a skull crusher that lets you load the triceps heavy.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: barbell (Olympic bar); weight plates; rack with J-hooks (power rack, squat stands or bench uprights); flat bench.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for triceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.3 for chest (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.2 for front delts: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Lie on a bench holding the bar with a close grip over your chest.
Lower by bending your elbows and letting the bar travel toward your upper chest or chin.
Press back up to straight arms.

form_cues.cue: Lower the bar toward your chin by bending elbows forward
Start light. The hybrid path takes a few sessions to learn.

mistakes.text: Letting it turn into a regular bench press.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where you can fail a rep safely, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
